description: Minified version of vis.js, a dynamic, browser-based visualization library. This file contains the entire vis.js library bundled into a minified JavaScript file, including modules for DataSet, DataView, Network, and utilities, with a focus on network visualization features.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a visual edge between nodes, with methods for rendering and border calculations.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the network, with properties for position, size, and rendering.

classes.name: PhysicsEngine
classes.description: Manages physics simulation for network layout, including force calculations, stabilization, and node movements.

classes.name: Cluster
classes.description: Handles grouping of nodes into clusters, with properties for contained nodes and cluster position.

methods.name: convertDot
methods.description: Converts DOT language descriptions to graph objects using the dotparser.

methods.name: convertGephi
methods.description: Converts Gephi graph representations to vis.js graph format.

methods.name: createEdge
methods.description: Creates a new edge object with specified options.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new node object with properties from options.
